name: discord-bot
description: A Discord bot for the MHFU Blacksmith site's data: a Cloudflare Worker on Discord's HTTP interactions endpoint.

scripts.bundle-size: tsx scripts/build-index.ts && esbuild src/worker.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --conditions=workerd,worker,browser --main-fields=module,main --external:node:* --minify --outfile=dist/worker.js --metafile=dist/meta.json && gzip -c dist/worker.js | wc -c
